high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the website "KOIMOI," which appears to be reporting on the financial performance of a film. The page is titled "Check out the latest breakdown of the film's worldwide collection." It provides specific revenue figures for different regions: North America: $144.7 million International: $110.5 million Worldwide: $255.2 million Below these figures, there is a statement that says the film has surpassed every Insidious film's individual global hauls. The text mentions that the Insidious franchise was created by Leigh Whannell
